dimension_description: This scale treats FLOPs pragmatically as floating-point operations per second, the throughput measure most people mean when they compare processors, GPUs, AI accelerators, and supercomputers. It now includes AI-flavored reference points such as approximate LLM inference workloads and training-scale estimates alongside direct hardware specs. Precision mode still matters in real hardware, so the notes are representative rather than exhaustive.
